svg.text: NestJS API · Prisma · Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage) · BullMQ/Redis — state after Phase 1 hardening, Nov 2026
③ every call: Authorization: Bearer <app JWT> (+ X-Business-Id)
NESTJS API · /API · REST · SWAGGER AT /API/DOCS (NON-PRODUCTION ONLY)
Keeps slow sends out of requests
Every store belongs to a business · tenant data keyed by businessId · memberships carry roles
Row-level security ON for every table, no policies → Supabase Data API (anon key) sees nothing;
the API (table owner) bypasses RLS, so app-level tenant checks are the primary control
blocked (403) until its phase adds rules
Orders: NEW → CONFIRMED → PREPARING → READY → DISPATCHED → DELIVERED / CANCELLED; payment agreed on WhatsApp, off-platform. Business roles: OWNER > ADMIN > MANAGER > EMPLOYEE > VIEWER.
